scope.summary: Implement auto-size for area/point stories: auto_width (grow horizontally), auto_height (wrap and grow vertically), fixed (clip/overset), with mode switching on manual resize; optional truncation with an ellipsis after a configurable maximum line count; repositionable start/end points on the bounding box preserved across resize (provenance Figma auto-resize + truncation; Photoshop dynamic text). Operator-visible sizing controls plus typed model command.
acceptance_criteria: auto_width/auto_height/fixed + ellipsis truncation; handles preserved on resize; GUI + model surface
expected_tests: live: auto_width/auto_height/fixed switch on manual resize; ellipsis truncation at max line count
argus: bounding-box start/end handles preserved across resize

risk_if_missed: Text frames cannot grow/clip; overset + truncation unsupported.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
